title: CoinRun PPO-stage trajectory ablation for dynamics
question: At fixed tokenizer, dynamics architecture, optimizer budget and held-out futures, how does the PPO checkpoint used to collect training trajectories affect CoinRun dynamics rollout quality?
reason: The earlier action-conditioned world model used a broken 16-action/no-op contract and non-learned trajectories, then failed user evaluation. CR-PPO-0002 produced a source-aligned checkpoint chain with materially stronger CoinRun behavior, so policy maturity can now be isolated as a data-quality variable.
hypothesis: Later PPO checkpoints produce more coherent, goal-directed action-state coverage, so a fixed medium dynamics model trained on later-stage trajectories will improve held-out mean-frame PSNR, horizon-16 PSNR and SSIM relative to the 1,048,576-transition corpus.
falsification: Reject a simple policy-maturity explanation if the final-policy corpus does not outperform the earliest corpus on both mean-frame PSNR and mean SSIM under the fixed final-policy evaluation set, or if the ordering is materially non-monotonic.

source.source_freeze: Pending the preregistration commit. No new corpus or dynamics result was observed when this manifest was written.

data.transition_alignment: raw_video[t]=observation_t, actions[t]=action_t, rewards[t]=reward observed after action_t
data.episode_boundary_policy: discard partial chunk on terminal; no record crosses reset
data.audit: All four training corpora and the fixed evaluation corpus must pass individual ArrayRecord audits plus the stage-corpus identity audit before dynamics starts.

compute.estimated_budget: Four medium 20k dynamics arms plus collection and evaluation; approximately 10-16 A10-hours, with CR-DYN-0007 adding further time.
compute.shutdown_policy: One existing A10 only, serial arms, no concurrent PPO/tokenizer job; bounded shutdown timer refreshed only when less than four hours remain.

success_criteria.rule: All four training corpora contain exactly 2,048 episode-safe 64-frame records, use the exact registered PPO checkpoints, preserve the 15-action/no-op-4 contract, and pass the stage-corpus audit.
All four medium dynamics arms complete exactly 20,000 optimizer updates from scratch with the same 16.6M EMA tokenizer and no silent OOM-driven protocol change.
All arms are evaluated against the same 32 held-out final-policy futures with context 16, horizon 16 and seed 4242.

Support the hypothesis only if the final-stage corpus exceeds the earliest-stage corpus on both mean-frame PSNR and mean SSIM; report any non-monotonic intermediate ordering without smoothing it away.
